mapper.sql: id, user_id, name, system_key, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM profile_collections WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE system_key WHEN 'general' THEN 0 WHEN 'inbox' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, name, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profile_collections (id, user_id, name, system_key, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{systemKey}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
